reason: We're opening accounts to agents and rate limits don't get me per-customer mandates, a person-in-the-loop over limits, or a kill switch, and they certainly don't get me something I can hand an examiner. $1,500, refundable, shadow-only, and I can run it on our own API keys without touching their passport registry. objection: This is an inline proxy in our trading path from a company with zero customers and no SOC 2 work started. And AINRA is a registry the founder started, so I won't rely on passports until someone independent governs it. Our API keys only.
would_change_my_mind: If infosec says an unaudited proxy can't sit inline even in shadow mode, or it adds measurable latency to order calls, I walk.
